steps.template_en: ANOVA tests if k group means EQUAL. H₀: μ₁=μ₂=...=μₖ. Compare BETWEEN-group vs WITHIN-group variability. F = MS_between/MS_within ~ F_{k-1,n-k} under H₀.
steps.template_zh: ANOVA检验k组均值相等。H₀: μ₁=μ₂=...=μₖ。比较组间vs组内变异。F=MS_between/MS_within~F_{k-1,n-k}。

steps.template_en: One-way ANOVA: Yᵢⱼ=μ+αᵢ+εᵢⱼ, αᵢ=group effect, Σαᵢ=0. SS_between=Σnᵢ(Ȳᵢ.-Ȳ..)². SS_within. Reject if F>F_crit. Post-hoc: Tukey's HSD for pairwise comparisons.
steps.template_zh: 单因素ANOVA: Yᵢⱼ=μ+αᵢ+εᵢⱼ。事后：Tukey HSD用于配对比较。

steps.template_en: Two-way ANOVA: Yᵢⱼₖ=μ+αᵢ+βⱼ+(αβ)ᵢⱼ+εᵢⱼₖ. Tests: (1) Factor A. (2) Factor B. (3) INTERACTION. Parallel lines = no interaction. Crossing = interaction.
steps.template_zh: 双因素ANOVA。检验：(1)A主效应。(2)B主效应。(3)交互。平行线=无交互。交叉=有交互。

steps.template_en: Assumptions: (1) Independence. (2) Homoscedasticity (Levene's test). (3) Normality (Q-Q). ANOVA ROBUST to normality violations for moderate n (CLT). Welch's ANOVA if variances unequal.
steps.template_zh: 假设：(1)独立。(2)同方差(Levene检验)。(3)正态(Q-Q)。中等n时ANOVA稳健。方差不等用Welch。

steps.template_en: In R: summary(aov(y~group)). (1) Interpret F-test. (2) Check residuals. (3) TukeyHSD(). Which groups differ? (4) Add block: aov(y~group+block). Why block? (5) Effect sizes η², ω².
steps.template_zh: 在R中：(1)解释F检验。(2)检查残差。(3)TukeyHSD()。哪些组不同？(4)加区组。为什么？(5)效应量η²,ω²。

steps.template_en: ANOVA = SPECIAL CASE of linear regression. F-test for group differences = F-test for β₁=...=β_{k-1}=0 with k-1 dummy variables. 'ANOVA' and 'regression' are SAME model — historical terminology.
steps.template_zh: ANOVA=线性回归特例。组差异F检验=有k-1个虚拟变量的回归。'ANOVA'和'回归'相同模型——历史术语。
